verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware FIDO2/passkey security key. It is operated by physical touch confirmation and managed through a conventional command-syntax CLI, so natural-language command operation is a category error for this product type. The solokeys.com llms.txt is Shopify's platform-generated shopping-agent file for the store, not a product capability, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
